messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2026-06-18] standup/ember/2026-06-18: Team Ember on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-06-16] standup/ember/2026-06-16: The weekly architecture review is run by Oskar.
- [2026-05-18] standup/ember/2026-05-18: Oskar Lind picked up the Ember on-call shift from Diego today.
- [2026-03-09] standup/atlas/2026-03-09: On-call rotation: Marcus Oyelaran is primary for team Atlas starting today; Priya is off rotation.
- [2026-02-12] standup/ember/2026-02-12: Ember on-call swapped this morning. Oskar carries the phone until the next rotation. Heads-up from team Ember: the search indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.
- [2025-06-13] standup/ember/2025-06-13-2: Team Ember planning meeting is every Friday.
- [2026-01-15] standup/ember/2026-01-15: For newcomers: the deploy window for the ledger service is still on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2026-06-08] standup/dune/2026-06-08: Rotation day for Dune: Tomasz hands the pager to Farah.
- [2025-06-05] standup/boreal/2025-06-05: On-call rotation: Marcus Oyelaran is primary for team Boreal starting today; Lena is off rotation.
- [2025-06-20] handover/2025-06-20-webhooks: Webhooks has a new home: Ember. Atlas kept it until today.
- [2025-09-08] standup/boreal/2025-09-08: The Boreal team on-call swapped this morning. Marcus carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-06-05] standup/boreal/2025-06-05-2: Lena Fischer is the release captain for Q1 2026.
- [2025-01-14] standup/ember/2025-01-14: Oskar Lind is on call for the Ember team to start the year.
- [2026-04-16] standup/ember/2026-04-16: The ledger service's deploy window changes today: it is now on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC. The old slot (Wednesdays 09:00-11:00 UTC) is retired.
- [2026-03-09] standup/atlas/2026-03-09-2: Observation from Atlas: after the runtime upgrade, the scheduler's cold start time tripled.
- [2025-09-22] standup/dune/2025-09-22: On-call rotation: Farah Haddad is primary for the Dune team starting today; Tomasz Nowak is off rotation.
- [2025-04-09] standup/cinder/2025-04-09: On-call rotation: Yuki Tanaka is primary for the Cinder team starting today; Diego Alvarez is off rotation.
- [2026-05-25] standup/atlas/2026-05-25: Marcus picked up the Atlas on-call shift from Priya today.
- [2025-06-13] standup/ember/2025-06-13: Decision: the scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node, because the fixed node turned every restart into a missed run.
- [2026-04-13] standup/dune/2026-04-13: On-call rotation: Tomasz is primary for Dune starting today; Farah is off rotation.
- [2026-03-10] standup/dune/2026-03-10: On-call rotation: Farah is primary for Dune starting today; Tomasz Nowak is off rotation.
- [2026-02-04] standup/dune/2026-02-04: Team Dune on-call swapped this morning. Tomasz Nowak carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-03-31] standup/ember/2026-03-31: Diego Alvarez has the Ember pager this cycle, taking over from Oskar. Ember saw that the feature flag service's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-03-19] standup/ember/2026-03-19: No deploys to the ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close.
- [2026-05-18] standup/ember/2026-05-18-2: The Ember team noticed that auth-gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.
- [2026-03-19] standup/ember/2026-03-19-2: Team Ember noticed that the job scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.
- [2026-02-10] handover/2026-02-10-reporting: The reports pipeline has a new home: the Cinder team. Ember kept it until today.
- [2026-03-16] standup/boreal/2026-03-16: From today the product catalog deploys on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC instead of on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.
- [2025-07-04] handover/2025-07-04-webhooks-correction: Fixing an error in the 2025-06-20 handover: the new owner of the webhooks service is Dune. Ember was recorded by mistake and never held it.
- [2025-12-16] standup/ember/2025-12-16: The ledger service deploy window (unchanged): on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-11-06] standup/dune/2025-11-06-2: Dune planning meeting is every Wednesday.
- [2025-06-23] standup/atlas/2025-06-23: The quarterly capacity review is run by Priya.
- [2025-09-09] standup/boreal/2025-09-09: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.
- [2025-06-19] handover/2025-06-19-notifier: Notifier has a new home: team Dune. Cinder kept it until today.
- [2025-01-06] standup/atlas/2025-01-06: Team Atlas this year is Priya and Tomasz Nowak.

Question: Who was on call for Ember on 2026-06-09?
